With a real vault at 1060 the layout also fits. Bridge hash (MEDIUM): FIXED. Clicking Bridge shows #nullswap within 0.3s (with and without a vault) and the Bridge view or gate renders. Private route 'Total fees $1.57 (1.85%)' with route fee, send, receive and gas rows. Custom-domain review: no hardcoded preview host in frontend/src, frontend/public, backend/*.py or backend/brand/*; the backend builds the origin from x-forwarded-host and x-forwarded-proto.

ui_bugs.issue: Reloading or deep-linking /app#nullswap, and back/forward onto #nullswap, renders the Home view instead of Bridge (vault: Private balance dashboard; no vault: generic WALLET gate). Clicking the Bridge tab works.
The receive asset is not carried for Ethereum-mainnet tokens (ETH or USDC on Ethereum). It works for Base.

issues: The Privacy swap subtitle reads 'No wallet · shielded cross-chain'. The label itself is clean, but a text match on 'Chain' also hits this row ('cross-chain').

action_items: Fix the #nullswap deep link and history navigation. Root cause: the shim maps #nullswap->#veilswap only once, at script start, then hashBrand() rewrites the URL back to #nullswap (via hpatch or the 3.5s interval). The upstream app reads the hash later (after vault restore) or on popstate/hashchange and sees the unknown '#nullswap', so it falls back to Home. Suggested fix: register a capture-phase popstate/hashchange listener in the shim that does hr(...'#veilswap') before the app's handlers run when the hash is #nullswap (then re-brand after a tick). For the load case, keep #veilswap until the app has actually routed (e.g. wait for the Bridge view or gate to render), or have the app treat #nullswap as an alias.

Fix the carry-over chain matching in dk-swap.js method switch: the NEAR catalog uses chainName 'Ethereum' (chain 'eth') while the Private route catalog uses 'Ethereum Mainnet' (chain 'ethereum'). Normalize chain names (strip ' mainnet', map eth<->ethereum, bsc<->binance smart chain, etc.) or compare by a canonical chain key instead of exact chainName.
critical_code_review_comments: bifrost_brand.py L98 + L95/L99/L103: the hash alias is a one-shot at load. The URL rewrite races the app's own hash routing, so any later read by the app sees an alias it does not know.
dk-swap.js L1169: matching on exact chainName across two different token catalogs is brittle. Use a normalized chain id.
dk-swap.js is very large (>1800 lines). Consider splitting the nav/fit, swap and fees modules.

Custom domain: OK. No hardcoded hosts; the origin is derived from x-forwarded-host and x-forwarded-proto; the frontend uses relative paths or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*', so set it explicitly for nullcash.fun if credentials are ever used.

rca of the issue: Carry-over: GET /api/ds/tokens?side=destination&term=ETH returns ETH with chainName 'Ethereum Mainnet', while /api/ds/near/tokens returns 'Ethereum', so the exact equality check in carry.chain never matches for Ethereum (Base, Arbitrum and Optimism match). Bridge deep link: after load, location.hash reads '#nullswap' at 2s and the main view stays Home for 12s+ across 2 reloads, which confirms the app never sees '#veilswap' when it routes.
